title: Close Your Eyes, You're Safe Now
music_prompt: Deep sleep music for a quiet rainy night, made to help an anxious mind fall asleep. Steady soft rain on a window and a roof, very distant low rolling thunder far away and rare, warm slow analog pads, sparse soft felt piano notes with long gentle reverb, a low warm cello drone, and a very soft, breathy female voice humming slowly and quietly far in the background like a lullaby. About 50 BPM, key of C major with warm, safe chords, no drums, no percussion, no beat, no sudden changes, no build-ups, no climax, no fade-in and no fade-out: it starts and ends at the same soft, low level and stays perfectly even so it loops seamlessly for hours. Feeling: safe, held, warm, heavy eyelids.
